source.book: 剑桥KET青少版官方真题2（扫描版）

parts.1:
Test Three. There are five parts to the test. You will hear each piece twice. We will now stop for a moment. Please ask any questions now because you must NOT speak during the test.
PART 1
Now look at the instructions for Part One.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at question one.
Question 1
One. How did the girl get to school this morning?
Man: You were a bit late for class! Was the bus late?
Girl: I know that's the usual problem, but I woke up late.
Man: Oh no!
Girl: But my brother gave me a lift on his motorbike. I asked Mum to drive me, but our car didn't start so I went with my brother. It was quite scary but fun!
Man: Lucky you!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 2
Two. What time will the friends meet tomorrow?
Boy: It's great that we can play tennis together tomorrow.
Girl: You said you're free to meet after the last class?
Boy: Yeah, how about just after – at ten past one? I have to get the bus at five past three but that gives us nearly two hours.
Girl: Perfect for me.
Boy: Great – see you tomorrow!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 3
Three. What did the boy enjoy most at the meal last night?
Girl: How was your meal at your cousins' place last night?
Boy: Well, my uncle's a great cook.
Girl: I remember, you told me that he makes amazing bread, doesn't he?
Boy: Unfortunately, we didn't have any last night, but he made some lovely pizza. One of my cousins made dessert but it was a bit too sweet for me.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 4
Four. What does the girl need to buy?
Man: Are you ready for the camping trip tomorrow? You forgot your toothbrush last time.
Girl: I've already packed it, Dad. But I haven't got enough soap – I've just checked.
Man: Didn't you get some when you went to the chemist's?
Girl: I went to buy a comb and forgot – don't worry, I'll go again.
Man: OK, that's alright then.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 5
Five. Where's the girl now?
Man: Millie, where are you? I've come to pick you up from school and you're not here!
Girl: Dad! Are you in the car? I tried to phone you. School finished early. I walked to the bus stop with my friends and then got on the bus with them. It's OK, I know where to get off.
Man: Well next time, leave me a message!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part One.
parts.2:
PART 2
Now look at Part Two.
For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time. Look at questions 6–10 now. You have 10 seconds.
You will hear a teacher talking to students about a walking trip in a National Park.
Man: We're going on our walking trip this week. The weather will probably be too wet on Tuesday, so we're going on Thursday instead.
The bus will leave school at 8:15. Please be here at 7:45 so we can put all your bags on the bus.
There is water on the bus, so you don't need to bring any. There's nowhere to buy anything to eat, so have sandwiches with you.
The journey to the mountains isn't very long. I know there's a game you all play on your phones, but please don't bring them because it'll be very noisy. When we get to the National Park, I'll give you all a map.
It's going to be warm, so you won't need to wear a coat. A T-shirt is a good idea for our walk.
It will cost three pounds fifty each to get into the Park. We need to pay for the bus, too, so for the whole day it's six pounds thirty. Please bring this to school tomorrow
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Two.
parts.3:
PART 3
Now look at Part Three.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 11–15 now. You have 20 seconds.
You will hear Zac talking to his friend Kirsty about a trip to play in a badminton match.
Boy: Are you ready for the badminton match tomorrow, Kirsty? Does the bus leave from the school entrance?
Girl: Actually, Zac, we've got to get it outside the shopping centre opposite the petrol station.
Boy: OK.
Girl: Remember we have to be all in white, including our T-shirts and shorts.
Boy: What about trainers? Mine are black!
Girl: My brother's the same size as you – you can borrow his.
Boy: Thanks!
Girl: Is the new sports teacher coming?
Boy: Yeah. I don't know him well but it'll be nice to talk to him more on the trip. He's not as funny as other teachers, but his instructions are always clear.
Girl: Yeah, that's right. You know, it's my first time travelling for a match.
Boy: Well, the bus gets very warm so take some water. And I take music not a book – I feel sick reading on the bus, especially if I've eaten a lot.
Girl: Right. Do you think we'll win?
Boy: I'm glad we've got a great team for this match. In fact – I didn't think I was good enough to play! The other team aren't playing well and I think we'll probably win.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Three.
parts.4:
PART 4
Now look at Part Four.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Question 16
Sixteen. You will hear a teacher talking to her students. What's she doing?
Woman: So, I can see everyone's got the information you collected during our museum visit last week. And well done if you've brought photos. Today I'd like you to work in pairs and make a poster about the museum. We don't have lots of time so please start immediately – it shouldn't be necessary for you to finish this at home.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 17
Seventeen. You will hear two friends talking about reading. What does the boy say about the book he's just read?
Girl: What books have you read recently?
Boy: I've just read one about a boy who starts a school band. It's not got too many pages.
Girl: Would I like it? I didn't like the book you lent me about a clown.
Boy: Haha, I know you like stories based on facts, and this one teaches you a lot about music. Would you like to borrow it?
Girl: Yes, please.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 18
Eighteen. You will hear two friends talking about holidays. What was the worst problem with the boy's holiday?
Boy: Have you been on holiday this summer?
Girl: Not yet, we're going camping next week. Do you like camping?
Boy: Yes, but last time we went it rained constantly.
Girl: Oh no, you were unlucky! Was the campsite noisy?
Boy: Sometimes, but that didn't matter. What I hated most was having to go home early because I'd hurt my foot!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 19
Nineteen. You will hear a boy talking after a tennis match. How did he prepare for the match?
Girl: Well done! You played really well.
Boy: Thanks, I was lucky to win – that was one of the hardest tennis matches I've ever played. I'm glad I went to bed early every night last week – I needed lots of energy!
Girl: Yeah, what you eat is important too.
Boy: I didn't worry about that, and I didn't even practise more than usual!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 20
Twenty. You will hear Louisa talking to her friend about a football game. Why did Louisa miss the game?
Boy: Hi Louisa. Why didn't you come to the football game? I texted you about it. Were you ill or something?
Girl: Oh sorry, my phone battery ran out. So when I saw your message, it was already too late to go.
Boy: Oh right.
Girl: So, tell me earlier next time. And if I feel like it, I'll come!
Boy: Cool!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Four.
parts.5:
PART 5
Now look at Part Five.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 21–25 now. You have 15 seconds.
You will hear a girl talking to her grandpa about some places she went to with her parents. What was her opinion about her visit to each place?
Girl: We went to the cinema on Saturday, Grandpa.
Man: Did you enjoy that?
Girl: Well, it was a horror film. Dad and I were frightened but Mum wasn't.
Man: Then did you go to a restaurant?
Girl: Yes. The food was great but there weren't many people there. I think that's because eating there costs so much.
Man: Right.
Girl: On Sunday we went to an exhibition of old furniture at the museum. It sounds boring but it wasn't. I took some photos which'll be perfect for my history project.
Man: Great.
Girl: Then we went to the swimming pool. Some workers were repairing the lifts. Their machines were so loud we didn't stay long, but it was still fun.
Man: Oh.
Girl: We also had a walk in the forest. Mum told me not to make any noise and we might see some rabbits. I've always wanted to see them – and I did! It was amazing!
Man: Fantastic!
Girl: We also visited a market that sells things that don't cost much. Usually it's crowded but not then. We saw a clown there. Sometimes they're scary but he really made us laugh.
Man: Ha!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Five.
You now have six minutes to write your answers on the answer sheet.
[ping]
You have one more minute.
[ping]
That is the end of the test.

explanations.p1q1: 公交车晚点只是常见问题，女孩说 "I know that's the usual problem, but I woke up late."，汽车也无法发动（"our car didn't start"），最后是 "my brother gave me a lift on his motorbike"，坐哥哥的摩托车到学校，因此选择 A。
explanations.p1q2: 女孩确认 "You said you're free to meet after the last class?"，男孩提议 "how about just after – at ten past one?"，即一点十分见面，因此选择 A。他还说 "I have to get the bus at five past three"，三点零五只是他要赶公交车的时间，是干扰信息。
explanations.p1q3: 面包昨晚没有："we didn't have any last night"，表亲做的甜点 "it was a bit too sweet for me"，而 "he made some lovely pizza"，男孩觉得披萨很好吃，因此选择 C。
explanations.p1q4: 女孩说 "I've already packed it, Dad. But I haven't got enough soap – I've just checked."，牙刷已收好，需要买的是肥皂，因此选择 C。梳子只是她去药房时忘记买的东西："I went to buy a comb and forgot – don't worry, I'll go again."。
explanations.p1q5: 女孩说 "School finished early. I walked to the bus stop with my friends and then got on the bus with them."，提前放学后和朋友走到公交站并乘上公交车，因此选择 A。爸爸开车来接她（"Are you in the car?"），但她并不在车里。
explanations.p2q1: 老师说 "Please be here at 7:45 so we can put all your bags on the bus."，到校集合时间是 7:45，因此填 7:45。"The bus will leave school at 8:15." 中的 8:15 是出发时间，不要混淆。
explanations.p2q2: 老师说 "There's nowhere to buy anything to eat, so have sandwiches with you."，没地方买吃的，要自带三明治，因此填 sandwiches。车上有水："There is water on the bus, so you don't need to bring any."，水不用带。
explanations.p2q3: 老师说 "When we get to the National Park, I'll give you all a map."，到达国家公园后每人会拿到一张地图，因此填 map。手机是被禁止带的（"please don't bring them"），不要误填。
explanations.p2q4: 老师说 "It's going to be warm, so you won't need to wear a coat. A T-shirt is a good idea for our walk."，天气暖和不用穿外套，T 恤正合适，因此填 T-shirt。coat 是被排除的衣物。
explanations.p2q5: 老师先说门票 "It will cost three pounds fifty each to get into the Park."，加上车费后总结 "for the whole day it's six pounds thirty."，全天总费用 6.30 英镑，因此填 6.30。三英镑五十只是门票，不是总费用。
explanations.p3q1: 男孩问 "Does the bus leave from the school entrance?"，女孩纠正 "we've got to get it outside the shopping centre opposite the petrol station."，他们在购物中心外、加油站对面乘车，因此选择 B（商店附近），不是学校门口，也不是在加油站里。
explanations.p3q2: 女孩说 "Remember we have to be all in white, including our T-shirts and shorts."，T 恤和短裤两人都要自备白色的；Zac 的运动鞋是黑色的（"Mine are black!"），Kirsty 说 "My brother's the same size as you – you can borrow his."，可以借她哥哥的运动鞋，因此选择 A。
explanations.p3q3: Zac 评价新老师 "He's not as funny as other teachers, but his instructions are always clear."，指令总是很清楚，Kirsty 回答 "Yeah, that's right." 表示同意，因此选择 B（easy to understand）。"not as funny" 说明 A 不对，两人也没有说和他在一起有趣。
explanations.p3q4: Zac 说 "the bus gets very warm so take some water."，车上很热，让 Kirsty 带水，因此选择 B（something to drink）。他自己带的是音乐："And I take music not a book – I feel sick reading on the bus"，音乐和书是他自己的安排，不是给 Kirsty 的建议。
explanations.p3q5: Zac 说 "I'm glad we've got a great team for this match."，队伍很强；"In fact – I didn't think I was good enough to play!"，他原本觉得自己不够格参赛，所以入选令他惊讶，因此选择 C。他还预计 "we'll probably win"，并不担心打得差，A 不对。
explanations.p4q1: 老师说 "Today I'd like you to work in pairs and make a poster about the museum."，让学生两人一组制作海报，并强调 "please start immediately – it shouldn't be necessary for you to finish this at home."，这是课堂上要做的活动，因此选择 C。不是布置家庭作业，也不是介绍学校旅行。
explanations.p4q2: 男孩说这本书 "It's not got too many pages."，页数不多，并且 "this one teaches you a lot about music."，能学到很多音乐知识，因此选择 C（useful）。小丑只是女孩以前不喜欢的另一本书："I didn't like the book you lent me about a clown."，funny 和 long 都不成立。
explanations.p4q3: 男孩承认 "it rained constantly"，营地也 "Sometimes" 吵，但强调 "What I hated most was having to go home early because I'd hurt my foot!"，最糟糕的是脚受伤后不得不提前回家、假期变短，因此选择 B。
explanations.p4q4: 男孩说 "I'm glad I went to bed early every night last week – I needed lots of energy!"，为比赛积蓄精力每晚早睡，因此选择 B。饮食方面 "I didn't worry about that"，练习方面 "I didn't even practise more than usual"，A、C 都不对。
explanations.p4q5: 男孩问 "Were you ill or something?"，Louisa 解释 "my phone battery ran out. So when I saw your message, it was already too late to go."，手机没电，看到短信时已经太晚，她事先并不知道有比赛，因此选择 C。她不是赶到时太迟，也不是身体不舒服。
explanations.p5q1: 女孩说餐厅 "The food was great but there weren't many people there."，并解释原因 "eating there costs so much."，因为价钱太贵所以人少，因此选 D expensive。食物本身是好的，boring、noisy 都不符。
explanations.p5q2: 女孩说博物馆展览 "It sounds boring but it wasn't."，拍的照片 "which'll be perfect for my history project."，对历史作业很有用，因此选 H useful。
explanations.p5q3: 女孩说 "Some workers were repairing the lifts. Their machines were so loud we didn't stay long, but it was still fun."，修电梯的机器声音太大，待不久就离开了，因此选 F noisy。
explanations.p5q4: 女孩说在森林里 "we might see some rabbits. I've always wanted to see them – and I did! It was amazing!"，如愿看到一直想看的兔子、非常兴奋，因此选 C exciting。
explanations.p5q5: 女孩说在市场看到小丑 "Sometimes they're scary but he really made us laugh."，小丑逗得他们大笑，因此选 E funny。市场当时也不拥挤（"Usually it's crowded but not then"），不是 crowded。
